next.reason: 1985: 'Argument-2, if specified, must be a nonnumeric literal or alphanumeric data item.'; 2023: 'Argument-2, if specified, shall be of the same class as argument-1.'. Argument-1 may now be national (AR-15.68.3-1), so a national argument-2 is accepted with it. 1985 allowed only a nonnumeric literal or an alphanumeric data item.
